Return APPLY with one concrete, minimal workflow change. Preserve triggers, permissions, jobs, matrix, runners, environment, dependencies, shell commands, required checks and all original steps. For caching, add a narrow trusted actions/cache@v4 step or configure caching on an existing setup action. Key it by runner OS and the best available checked-in dependency inputs (lockfiles when present; otherwise dependency manifests, Makefile/install declarations and workflow setup). Cache only dependency download state, use exact keys without broad restore fallbacks, and always run every original install and test command on cache hits. Do not skip work based on cache-hit outputs. For timeout patterns change only job timeout-minutes, using baseline evidence with headroom. Do not add networking/deploy/publish/secret usage or replace action versions. The baseline already passed the required checks. Keep the change narrow so those same commands still run and can pass; the measured CI runs determine whether the candidate succeeds and whether it helps. If the method has a limitation, record it in rationale but still implement the closest valid version of the selected method. Return ONLY JSON: {pattern_id, decision: APPLY, rationale, workflow_yaml}. workflow_yaml must contain the complete changed file.

"required_job_names": ["build"], "workflow_yaml": "name: Build and test

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"

env:
  # Stop wasting time caching packages
  DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: true
  # Disable sending usage data to Microsoft
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: true

# Kill other jobs when we trigger this workflow by sending new commits
# to the PR.
# https://stackoverflow.com/a/72408109
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - name: Setup .NET Core
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.x
            9.x
            10.x
      - name: Restore
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet restore

      - name: Start containers
        working-directory: src/.devcontainer
        run: docker compose up -d --wait mssql postgresql orcl
      - name: Generated SqlFn matches pg_proc
        run: dotnet fsi src/SqlHydra.Query/codegen/NpgsqlSqlFn.fsx --check
      - name: Build
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet build --no-restore
      # After Build: the sqlite tomls load a codegen extension from the compiled Tests assembly.
      - name: Regenerate AdventureWorks schemas
        working-directory: src/Build
        run: dotnet run -- Regen
      - name: Generated code is current
        run: |
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- ':(glob)src/Tests/**/AdventureWorks*.fs')" ]; then
            git diff -- ':(glob)src/Tests/**/AdventureWorks*.fs'
            echo "::error::Generated AdventureWorks files are stale. Run 'dotnet run -- Regen' from src/Build (or src/Tests/regen-all.bat) and commit the result."
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Test net8.0
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet test --framework net8.0

      - name: Stop and Start containers
        working-directory: src/.devcontainer
        run: docker compose down && docker compose up -d --wait mssql postgresql orcl
      - name: Build
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet build --no-restore
      - name: Test net9.0
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet test --framework net9.0

      - name: Stop and Start containers
        working-directory: src/.devcontainer
        run: docker compose down && docker compose up -d --wait mssql postgresql orcl
      - name: Build
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet build --no-restore
      - name: Test net10.0
        working-directory: src/
        run: dotnet test --framework net10.0
